system.description:
An advanced version of the Clone Genjutsu that creates a solid clone using only chakra called a Shadow Clone. When a Shadow Clone is killed, it sends its most recent experiences within the last minute as thoughts and images to its Summoner. A creature looking at a Shadow Clone with chakra sight cannot tell that it is not a real person unless otherwise specified.

When this jutsu is cast, by spending 6 chakra, you summon one Clone. You can spend 4 additional chakra to summon 1 additional Clone. You can spend 4 additional chakra in this way to summon additional Clones up to 3 times per casting.

All Shadow Clones act at once and attempt to perform the same command given. If commanded to perform the help action, they can only help the caster. Shadow Clones have non-enhanced versions of your weapons. Weapons your Shadow Clone is summoned with that has the ammunition property cannot be given to anyone. Shadow Clones summoned outside of combat, can exist up to 1 mile away. If they would enter combat, they are immediately dispelled.

Casting this jutsu while you have an active Clone dispels all currently active Clones.

If this jutsu is cast while out of combat, its duration instead becomes 1 hour. If combat would begin, their duration shifts to 1 minute.

At Higher Ranks:. For each rank above C-Rank, increase the number of clones you can create with this jutsu by +1. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of Jutsu Slots your Clones have by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the number of Jutsu Slots your Clones have by +1 and for every 2 Shadow Clones you have active at once, increase your AC by +1.
